g.text: The translation layer — syn::Meta in, openings out
Nothing here invents a node layer beside it
— Meta already IS the set of shapes an
attribute can be written in, and
which is what lets a terminal node choose
a bare literal is not valid Meta at all.
These two methods ARE the Meta-spine /
Expr-leaf rule, made into an API.
, and needs no parser of ours:
a shape is SELECTED by a type path rustc
resolves, never by an ident we compare, so
path that must never be used.
A shape is not a tag we attach — it is
WHICH OPENING the payload arrives through.
is the bridge. Without it the
type-level markers and the runtime Opening
joining them, and a WrongShape diagnostic
had to hand-write both halves with no
The check is now direct, with no string on
a variant cannot be named in type position,
and the selector has to be an ARGUMENT to
the whole recursion — the spine goes as deep
as there are named nodes, and
re-emits what it came from unchanged. The
round-trips verbatim into a type position.
